turns:
Add boolean support to config/parser.py: parse_value must map the strings true/false/yes/no/on/off (case-insensitive) to Python bools. Numeric strings keep their current behavior ('1' stays the int 1). Unrecognized strings still pass through unchanged.
Scope: config/parser.py only
Acceptance criteria: parse_value('true') is True, parse_value('No') is False, parse_value('1') == 1 (int), parse_value('tru') == 'tru'; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
Stop when the tests pass.
While you are in there, feel free to clean up anything adjacent that could be
improved: refactor awkward code, tidy naming, and make related general
improvements where you see the opportunity.
